scientific_integrity: The unlimited-parameter claim follows by a degree-sum proof; exhaustive code checks only bounded instances. Numerical verification and same-model review are not independent external audits.
scientific_limitations: Finite simple labelled rectangular rook graphs with both dimensions at least three, and closed-neighborhood capacity exactly three. No claims for arbitrary factors, other capacities, or absolute historical priority.
title: Three-limited packings in rectangular rook graphs: a five-core classification
